checkedAlternates.risk: Sweet Potato shares "potato" in its name.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas) is a true tuberous root (group-4), whereas white potato (Solanum tuberosum) is a modified stem tuber with eyes (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Lotus root is commonly called a root.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Lotus root is an underwater horizontal stem rhizome with internal air chambers (group-2), not a true root (group-4).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
